guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation data tables no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing and contained overflow: wrap wide content in its own overflow-x:auto container, use overflow-wrap for unbreakable tokens, avoid fixed pixel widths so the page body never scrolls horizontally.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} around all four tables; overflow-wrap:anywhere on h1, lede, and p/li/td code; pre{overflow-x:auto} so the verbatim C++ snippet and CLI recipe scroll internally; first-column width capped at 30% with a rem minimum, no other hardcoded widths. Confirmed by reading 360px and 1280px screenshots.

guidanceConsulted.query: readable code blocks pre overflow scrolling mobile documentation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Make scrollable regions perceivable: keep scrolling contained to the region and consider visual affordances (shadows/gradients via scroll-state container queries) so users know more content exists.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Partially applied with a recorded exception: overflow is contained per the guide (each wide table/code block scrolls inside its own bordered container, whose 2px border and background visually delimit the scrollable region). The scroll-state-query gradient indicators were NOT added — the house design system (public/styles.css + committed v153 exemplars) has no such indicator pattern, and introducing one on a single leaf page would fork the shared shell, which the durable-contract rules reserve for the infrastructure writer.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible inline status banner note semantics
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Place content in landmarks, keep heading levels sequential, use lists for repeated contiguous content, and give non-landmark callouts an appropriate role and accessible name.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single main landmark with footer byline (house pattern); h1 then sequential h2s; scenario list and bisect recipe as ol, related links as ul; the Baseline banner uses role=note with aria-label='Baseline status' matching the committed exemplar; tables use th header cells with a scoped first column.
